claim: Combining reach, understanding, and behavior into one single success metric prevents leadership from making strategic decisions.

evidence.detail: A structured communication measurement framework separates outputs, out-takes, outcomes, and business impact instead of combining them into a single score.

slides.headline: Combining every metric into one score hides operational risk
slides.body: Impressions show distribution. Merging them hides failures.

slides.headline: Track delivery separate from comprehension
slides.body: Outputs track delivery. Out-takes test recall.

slides.headline: Measure behavior change before claiming impact
slides.body: Outcomes capture actions. Impact measures results.

slides.headline: The structure of a one-page leadership scorecard
slides.body: Include objectives, baselines, and data limits.

slides.headline: How to measure understanding on a small budget
slides.body: Ask open scenario questions before showing copy.

slides.body: Delivery is not comprehension. Remove unused data.

slides.headline: Reports must end with decisions.
slides.body: Read the full framework on practical B2B communication measurement on my website. Send this to whoever is building your team's scorecard.

caption:
Reach metrics stop decisions.

Effective brand governance relies on reporting structures that force operational choices rather than aggregate vanity totals. Combining impressions, press mentions, and internal feedback into a single composite index hides local operational failures.

A board deck showing millions of potential impressions provides zero insight into whether key account managers understand a service change. Operational diagnostics belong in channel management files, not the executive summary.

When building a governance scorecard, isolate delivery metrics from recall tests and behavior tracking. Every line on the summary page must support a specific operational decision, complete with explicit limits and alternative explanations.

Measurement isn't about proving value through inflated totals; it is about providing clear inputs for resource allocation.

The detailed framework is available at rachitmishra.in
